9c7f90933cb78873.description: **On-Site, Hyderabad, India · Full-Time** > **Only apply if:** You have **≥ 1 year** of production-grade experience building and shipping **cross-platform mobile apps (iOS + Android)** using **Flutter or React Native** — **and** you can point us to **live apps on the App Store / Google Play** that you have built. Web development (React / Next.js) is a strong secondary skill. --- ## Who We Are We are a fast-growing product startup building intelligent, AI-powered software for modern businesses. Our focus is on crafting seamless, high-performance user experiences across mobile and web, powered by scalable backend systems and data-driven intelligence — and we ship to real customers every week. As we scale, we are looking for a **Mobile-first SDE** who can take end-to-end ownership of our iOS and Android apps from a **single cross-platform codebase**, and who can also contribute to our web products when needed. --- ## What You'll Do ### Core Mobile Development (Primary) - Build and ship production-grade **iOS and Android apps from one codebase** using **Flutter (Dart)** and/or **React Native (Expo, TypeScript)**. - Architect scalable, modular mobile apps with clean architecture and reusable component libraries / design systems. - Implement robust state management (**Riverpod / Bloc / Provider** for Flutter; **Zustand / Redux Toolkit / TanStack Query** for React Native). - Build smooth, responsive, accessible UIs that feel native on both platforms, with 60/120 fps animations and gestures. - Integrate native device capabilities: camera, location/maps, biometrics, push notifications, deep links, background tasks, in-app purchases, offline storage and sync. - Write platform-specific code (Swift / Kotlin, platform channels, native modules) when a feature needs it. - Own the release process: code signing, **TestFlight / Play Console**, staged rollouts, OTA updates, crash and performance monitoring (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry). - Optimize app startup time, memory, battery usage, and bundle size through profiling. ### Meta Platform & AI-Driven Experiences - Build **Meta app development–related features**: integrations with Meta platforms (WhatsApp Business Platform, Messenger, Instagram, Meta Graph API, Facebook Login, Meta SDKs, app review and permissions flows). - Build **AI-driven, streaming mobile interfaces** — chat/agent UIs, token-by-token streaming, real-time updates, and rich message rendering (markdown, code). - Integrate real-time features using **WebSockets, SSE / streaming APIs, FCM/APNs push, or event-driven updates**. - Build complex multi-step workflows, dashboards, and data-heavy views (charts, lists, maps) optimized for mobile. ### Web Development (Secondary) - Build and maintain web apps using **Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS**. - Share logic, design tokens, and API clients between mobile and web where possible (TypeScript monorepo, shared SDKs, or Flutter Web where appropriate). - Apply sound rendering strategies (**SSR / SSG / ISR / CSR**) and keep web performance and accessibility high. - Contribute to **embeddable / SDK-style web widgets** where relevant. ### Architecture & Backend Integration - Integrate with backend services (**TypeScript/Node and Python**) over **REST and/or GraphQL** APIs. - Implement secure authentication (**JWT, OAuth, social login, Sign in with Apple/Google, session-based auth**) and secure token storage. - Design offline-first data layers and caching strategies; handle large paginated and infinite lists efficiently. - Ensure robust error handling, observability, analytics, and performance monitoring. - Drive testing strategy: unit, widget/component, integration, and E2E tests (**flutter_test, Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, Maestro, Patrol**; **Cypress/Playwright** for web). ### Engineering & Collaboration - Translate product requirements and Figma designs into polished mobile and web implementations. - Conduct structured code reviews and enforce high-quality coding standards. - Collaborate closely with backend engineers, product managers, and designers. - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for mobile and web (**GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Codemagic, EAS**). - Take ownership of features from concept to production release; mentor junior engineers. --- ## Must-Have Qualifications ### Mobile Expertise (Primary) - **≥ 1 year** of production experience shipping cross-platform mobile apps to both the **App Store and Google Play**. - Strong command of **Flutter + Dart** and/or **React Native + TypeScript**; willingness to learn the other. - Solid understanding of iOS and Android platform conventions, app lifecycle, permissions, and Human Interface / Material Design guidelines. - Experience with state management, navigation, local storage (SQLite / Hive / Drift / MMKV / WatermelonDB), and offline sync. - Experience with push notifications, deep linking, and app store release and review processes. - Experience with mobile performance profiling and optimization. ### API & Integration - Experience integrating mobile and web clients with **Node.js and Python** backends. - Strong understanding of **REST APIs and/or GraphQL**. - Familiarity with authentication systems (**JWT, OAuth, session-based auth**) and secure data handling on devices. - Experience handling streaming responses, WebSockets, and large paginated datasets. ### Web Skills (Secondary) - Working knowledge of **React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS**. - Understanding of rendering strategies (**SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR**) and responsive, accessible web design. - Familiarity with form handling and validation (**React Hook Form, Zod**) and data fetching (**TanStack Query**). ### DevOps & Quality - CI/CD familiarity for mobile (**Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Codemagic, EAS**) and web. - Strong Git workflows and collaborative branching strategies. - Testing mindset spanning unit, integration, and E2E coverage. - Comfort with Docker-based local development workflows. ### Engineering Mindset - Clean, maintainable code adhering to SOLID principles. - Strong debugging and performance-profiling skills. - Ownership-driven, product-first thinking. - Comfortable working independently in an **in-office startup environment**. --- ## Critical Requirements – High Weightage > **This is non-negotiable. Applications without these will not be prioritized.** ### Portfolio, Live Apps & Demos You must be able to **show, not just tell**. With your application, explicitly share: - **An active GitHub profile** showcasing real, production-grade mobile code (not just tutorials or forks). - **Live apps** — **App Store and/or Google Play links** (or TestFlight / internal-testing builds) that we can install and use right now. Flutter or React Native + TypeScript projects strongly preferred. - **A portfolio or demo reel** (site, video walkthrough, or screen recordings) highlighting your **UI/UX craftsmanship** — visual quality, animations, interaction design, and polish you are personally responsible for. - **At least one live web project** (URL) built with React / Next.js, as secondary proof of web skills. - Demonstrated ability to build **complex SaaS products, AI-integrated UIs, real-time apps, or data-heavy interfaces**. - Clean code structure, thoughtful architecture, and clear documentation. **In your application, please include direct links to:** https://forms.gle/FPUtQZ9ebgHPeAH59 1. Your GitHub profile (and 1–3 specific repos you're proud of). 2. At least one **live mobile app** (App Store / Google Play URL) you built or substantially contributed to. 3. A **portfolio / demo** that highlights your UI/UX craftsmanship. 4. A **live web project** URL (secondary). Tell us, for each link, exactly what you built and which parts are yours. ### Technical Assessment We will evaluate your: - Mobile architecture design and scalability decisions. - Code quality and maintainability. - Performance optimization strategy (startup time, rendering, memory). - Ability to convert product requirements and Figma designs into production-ready mobile UI. - End-to-end ownership during feature implementation, including release readiness. --- ## Nice-to-Have - Experience with **both Flutter and React Native**, or with native **Swift / SwiftUI** and **Kotlin / Jetpack Compose**. - Experience building **AI-powered, streaming, or real-time mobile interfaces** (on-device ML, voice, chat/agent UIs). - Experience with **Meta platform integrations** (WhatsApp Business API, Instagram/Facebook Graph API, Meta SDKs). - Experience with **Flutter Web, React Native Web, or monorepos** (Nx / Turborepo) sharing code across mobile and web. - Experience building **embeddable widgets / SDKs**. - Exposure to animation tooling (**Rive, Lottie, Reanimated, Framer Motion**). - Experience with Firebase / Supabase, analytics, A/B testing, and feature flags. - Contributions to open-source Flutter / React Native / React projects. - Experience working in early-stage startups. --- ## What We Offer - Competitive salary with a strong growth trajectory. - High-impact role with direct influence on product direction. - Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI-driven products across mobile and web. - Fast execution cycles and a strong ownership culture. - Learning budget for courses and certifications. - Collaborative in-office engineering culture in **Hyderabad**. --- **https://forms.gle/FPUtQZ9ebgHPeAH59** If you are passionate about building beautiful, high-performance iOS and Android apps — and want to shape the product experience of a growing startup — **send us your GitHub, your live apps, and your portfolio.** We'd love to see what you've shipped.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
As a Financial Manager focused onTechnology Infrastructure, you will have financial and strategic oversight for managing and optimizing the significant investments Pinterest makes in its technology infrastructure (primarily AWS, our cloud-based computational and storage provider). This is a critical role that sits at the center of how Pinterest executes its technology and innovation strategy. You will play a key role - in partnership with technology infrastructure leadership - in governing our infrastructure investments, managing key vendor relationships (especially AWS) and ensuring we can cost effectively serve Pinners and Advertisers while also enabling future technological innovation … while also being able to allocate and track costs at the appropriate level within the company. These teams and technology service providers are the foundation of our online service as well as how our Engineering, Product and Design teams execute their work.

What you’ll do:

• Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure and Technical Program Management teams to develop annual, monthly, and weekly operational investments and related infrastructure demand and financial forecasts

• Compile monthly, quarterly, and annual variance analysis

• Identify and drive initiatives to continuously improve, automate, and grow OPEX and infrastructure forecasting, and reporting tools and processes

• Champion and AI-First approach to Technology finance partnership — embedding AI tools into forecasting, metrics analysis, and finance decision-making to raise the bar for how Finance drives impact

• Design usage prediction models for short and long-term resource capacity needs

• Proactively identify risks and opportunities

• Perform strategic, time-sensitive analysis and communicate key takeaways

What we’re looking for:

• Experience with forecasting expenses, with a strong preference for prior experience managing technology infrastructure spending on public infrastructure cloud platforms and product offerings 

• Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate financial analysis and forecasting workflows, with a rigorous approach to validating outputs and maintaining critical ownership of final recommendations 

• Experience in managing multiple work-streams end-to-end along with working across multiple functions and teams

• Expertise in building high-level and detailed financial models

• Strong business partnership skills and verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multi-task and deliver against timelines

• Entrepreneurial, flexible, and collaborative mindset

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Accounting or Finance and a minimum of 5 years of Finance or Business Operational experience in a fast-paced industry

Relocation Statement:

•  This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement: 

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Headquarters: Remote

You've helped run a scale or pooled CS model before, or you've been inside one long enough to know what works and what doesn't. You know that scale CS done badly is just support with a fancier title, and done well it's a system that delivers consistent value to hundreds of customers. You want to join and help build the good version.

Expel is an MDR company. Our customers are security teams who depend on us to find and stop threats. We're launching a scale model for a segment of our customer base, and we're building it from scratch: the playbooks, the automation, the operating model, the measurement framework. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll be a primary contributor to designing it.

That means you're not just executing motions. You own specific programs within the model (new customer/onboarding cohorts, renewal campaigns, segment outreach), you exercise judgment on the edge cases the playbook doesn't cover, and you identify patterns across hundreds of customer interactions that tell you where the model needs to improve. When something breaks, you fix the process, not just the situation.

Your success is measured by the team's retention outcomes across the scale segment, the quality of your execution, and the motions you build and improve.

What Expel can do for you

• Put you at the center of building a scale CS model from scratch inside a security company, with the latitude to shape how it works

• Give you a company transforming security operations from industry-leading 20-minute outcomes toward 20-second outcomes with AI and automation, the kind of product story that makes CS conversations genuinely interesting

• Surround you with experienced CS leadership that has built scale models before and knows the difference between good and bad

• Connect you with customers who genuinely care about their security programs

• Offer a clear path to grow professionally as our scale program and company grow

What you can do for Expel

• Help design, execute and continuously improve playbook-driven customer interactions across the scale segment: new customer/onboarding, health checks, renewals, proactive outreach

• Own specific motions or programs within the model, from design through execution and measurement

• Exercise judgment on edge cases, distinguishing between situations that fit the playbook, situations that need a creative solution, and situations that require escalation

• Design and lead one-to-many customer engagements: webinars, digital campaigns, scaled communications

• Identify patterns in customer interactions and translate them into process improvements that make the scale function stronger

• Maintain technical credibility in every interaction, speaking knowledgeably about Expel's service, security operations, and common integration patterns

• Provide coaching and guidance to associate-level team members on process execution and customer handling

• Contribute to the design of the scale operating model itself: systems requirements, automation workflows, measurement frameworks

What you should bring with you

• 2+ years of customer success, account management, or customer-facing experience

• At least 2 years in the security industry (operations, products, consulting, GRC, or incident response)

9c20f2e1622881ab.description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium
 
URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

• You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.

• With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

• You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

• You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

• Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

• You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

• You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

• You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

• You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

• You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

• You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

• You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

• You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

• An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

• The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

• An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

• A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

• A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

• Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

• A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

• A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.

• The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

9c6470e40acbc857.description: ## About The Agency Fund The Agency Fund (TAF) is a US non-profit funder-doer that builds projects to expand human agency at scale. We embed engineers and product managers directly inside evidence-based nonprofits across East Africa, South Asia, and beyond — helping them build data infrastructure, run experiments, and scale impact through automation and product thinking. Our small, global team combines expertise in software, AI, social psychology, and development economics, and our community of 200+ partner organizations reaches millions of people annually. We're an entrepreneurial team that operates with minimal hierarchy — everyone contributes to a shared mission in unique ways. ## The Role We are growing our technical team to meet accelerating demand from our portfolio. As part of that growth, we are hiring a Technical Product Manager who will work at the heart of our accelerator — embedded with 3-4 NGO partners at a time, leading product engagements end-to-end, and helping shape how we deliver at scale. The TPM is a senior, delivery-focused role that sits at the center of TAF's accelerator work. You will split your time roughly 50/50 between partner-facing and internal-facing work: on one side, building trusted relationships with NGO partners and translating their needs into actionable product roadmaps; on the other, driving execution with TAF's engineering team through structured agile processes. You will get your hands dirty by building dashboards, scoping data pipelines, designing A/B tests, and unblocking engineers. You are expected to be as comfortable in SQL query as you are in a partner discovery call. Within 90 days, you should have sufficient agency to run engagements independently. Within a year, you should be training others. ## What You'll Do Partner engagement (50%): - Act as the primary interface with 3-4 NGO partners at any given time (building trust, scoping collaborations, and surfacing pain points through structured discovery) - Translate partner needs into roadmaps and technical advisory on product, data, evaluation, and experimentation - Report back on learnings from partner work, trace patterns across different organizations and help releasing the lessons learnt in the public goods that benefit the whole sector Product & engineering execution (50%): - Get your hands dirty with partner's platforms: build dashboards, data pipelines, AI evaluations and production integrations, analyze data to extract trends, run AB tests and perform user research - Define and drive product roadmaps across TAF's tools translating complex partner workflows into clear engineering requirements. Run agile sprints with TAF's engineering team - Ship critical features and own the full loop from partner need to shipped product to feedback Team and talent (ongoing): - Coach partner organization staff in the process, help upskilling their technical and leadership skills, help them hire for critical roles - Coach and mentor Lighthouse Fellows on how to navigate nonprofit partners, run structured engagements, and operate effectively in a resource-constrained environment - Contribute to TAF's internal playbook: document what works, codify engagement frameworks, and help build the institutional knowledge that makes us better over time ## Who You Are - You have 5+ years of experience in technical product management, solutions engineering, or tech consulting — ideally with both client/consumer-facing and engineering-facing responsibilities - You have shipped AI/LLM product features, data pipelines or warehouses, and production APIs — not just managed people who did, but actually built alongside them - You can read and write SQL, navigate a codebase, build data pipelines and dashboards - You have demonstrated experience using quantitative and qualitative methods to define problem statements, measure the effectiveness for causal inference (AB tests etc.) or predictive analytics. You can design a study, interpret the results, and present them to a non-technical program director - You are fluent in agile: sprints, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives. You run these processes well even when the team is small and everyone is wearing multiple hats - You can demonstrate you've managed competing stakeholder needs across engineers, behavioral scientists, and NGO program teams — without formal authority over any of them ## **Bonus points if you have:** - Experience with global development data stacks: ODK, DHIS2, Kobo, Metabase, dbt, or similar - Familiarity with the evidence-based development ecosystem — J-PAL, IPA, IDinsight, or similar RCT/MEL contexts - Have proven experience of scaling products with data-driven approaches - Exposure to GenAI product development — evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, LLM integrations - You have a meaningful track record in a low-resource, mission-driven, or Tech for International Development context ## What Success Looks Like At 90 days: - Fully ramped: you have independent agency with at least two NGO partners, are running your own sprint cadence, and are making decisions without needing to escalate routine calls - First quick win delivered: at least one experiment run, a feature shipped, a dashboard built with a partner At one year: - You have led 3-4 partner organizations engagement end-to-end, producing meaningful technical outcomes that led to tangible improvements for the users they serve - You are training others - coaching or hiring partner organization staff and Fellows on how to operate effectively in this context - You have meaningfully contributed to how TAF does this work: a framework improved, a process documented, a playbook built ## Location Remote (Sub-Saharan African or South Asia) - Flexible time zone
